notes.title: Together in Forgotten Lands: Chapter One – Hotfix #2
notes.content:
Dear Together in Forgotten Lands players,

We are thrilled to announce that over 20,000 players have already joined us on this journey thank you so much for your amazing support! 🙏 

Your feedback continues to guide our work, and with this hotfix, we’ve addressed some key issues and added new improvements.Here are the main changes in Hotfix #2:🎮 Gameplay & Audio
Fixed some minor bugs

Improved performance and stability

🎤 Microphone Options

You can now choose between Always On, Push-to-Talk, or Hold-to-Talk modes directly from the settings menu.

Thanks to the keybinding system, you can assign any key you want to activate the microphone.

We would like to thank those who provided us with this feedback during their reviews ❤️

🔍 Zoom Feature

We’ve added a Zoom function to help you see areas that are far away or out of sight.

Use Right Mouse Button (or Left Trigger on controllers) to zoom in and get a clearer view.


🖥️ UI & Settings
Fixed an issue where some players couldn’t click the Keybinding and Graphics Settings buttons.

Improved Keybinding UI (Vivox) integration.

Brightness adjustment bug identified; fix will be applied in the main menu.


🌍 Lobby & Visuals
Lighting improvements applied to the Lobby Menu for better atmosphere.



We know there’s still room for more polishing, and we’re already working on the next set of updates. Your continued feedback on Discord, Steam reviews, and direct reports is incredibly valuable for us.



If you want to get hints while solving the puzzles, you can check out this walkthrough


[previewyoutube="R1tA26dqjAc;full"][/previewyoutube]


Thank you for helping Together in Forgotten Lands grow and for being part of this adventure! 💜



👉 Found a bug? Please report it via the bug-report channel on our Discord server

notes.title: Together in Forgotten Lands: Chapter One Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Dear Together in Forgotten Lands players,First of all, thank you very much for the incredible support and detailed feedback you shared with us after the release of Chapter One. We carefully reviewed all the issues reported via Discord, Steam comments, and direct messages, and worked on fixing the most urgent ones. Here are the main improvements and fixes included in this hotfix:🎵 Audio & Feedback
Added missing sound effects.

Adjusted mud and environmental sound effects.

Fixed missing female character voice effects during certain sequences.
🎮 Gameplay & Animation
Improved crouch animation and added proper standing-up animation.

Adjusted female character hand positioning during walking and carrying.

Inventory now resets properly during scene transitions; characters spawn in the correct positions.

Default graphics quality lowered to avoid performance issues on lower-end PCs.
🖥️ UI & Lobby
Fixed “Enter Lobby Code” input field not allowing continuous typing.

Added missing sound tag to lobby door stones.

UI adjustment after pressing Load Game (Lobby button).

Fixed Vivox integration issue where players couldn’t join after someone left/rejoined the lobby.

ESC Menu slider now starts at 100 instead of 0 when connected to Vivox.

Added fade-out transition at the end of loading screens.

ESC and SplitScreen interactions are now disabled during loading screens.
🌍 Chapters & Environments
Adjusted Chapter 1 stone puzzle lighting.

Updated portal color indicators and furnace texts to match correctly.

Fixed hand animation bug when interacting with furnaces without holding an object.
📋 Miscellaneous Fixes
Updated Credits Wishlist button.

Fixed zoom issue in Credits.

Final credits no longer show a black screen.

Fixed subtitle placement for the narrator.

Updated RockLock sound effect.

Applied ReflectLight text updates consistently across elements.

We are aware that more polishing is needed, and we’re already working on additional improvements for the next updates. Your feedback is invaluable, and every report helps us move closer to the best possible experience.

Thank you all for supporting us and helping Together in Forgotten Lands grow!



You can report any bugs you encounter to us via the “bug-report” channel on our Discord server and support our development and improvement process.



Discord



Vellichor Games Team
